subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime object and helper layer: multi-phase vtable-switching destructors of a UI/DB object hierarchy, a media buffer manager with a buffer-reference node list, a season-scene path-match list walker with a mode-dependent command dispatcher, rectangle bounds checking, UI hit-testing over a coordinate node list, a large season/career database object factory with per-type caching, several linked-list container operations (destroy, index lookup, unlink, append), UI scroll/state/subscriber propagation, and a shared constant-zero stub.

summary: Twenty-six generic runtime objects and helpers. Two nearly identical multi-phase vtable-switch destructors (0x00476100, 0x004761E0) transition the vtable through off_5A4450 (HUD layer) and off_5A443C (control base) while freeing owned children (+0x50/+0x30/+0x4 and +0x40/+0x30/+0x4), destroying the +0x3C interface-node list, and conditionally freeing self on a2 bit 0; they are grouped as UILayerObjectTearDown (GUESS). MediaBufferManagerDestructor (0x00476730) frees a +0x188 buffer, resets the vtable to off_5A4550, drains the +0xF0 buffer-reference list, zeroes +0xF0..+0xFC and chains sub_485EB0. SeasonPathMatchSearch (0x00476660) walks the +0xF0 season-scene list comparing node paths to global dword_7D0434 (fallback byte_5EA438) and stores the match index at +0x174; dispatchSceneCommandByMode (0x00477810) dispatches through global dword_7CD8C0 vtable slot +28 with command 23 when +0x180 == 24 else command 21; both are called by SeasonSceneInitialization (0x00477720) and are grouped as SeasonSceneController (GUESS). BoundsCheckWithPositionQuery (0x004773A0) guards the DualFieldRead position against +0x120/+0x124/+0x140/+0x144 ranges. HitTest (0x00479320) does a +/-20-window hit test over the +0x164 coordinate node list and writes the hit index to +0x158. SeasonDBObjectInit (0x0047A9E0) initializes a season DB object (vtable off_5A66E0, -1 sentinel fields) and is produced by the SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory (0x0047F440), which caches 1-45 per-type objects at dword index (id-1)+1607 and special-cases id 436. Return0Stub (0x0047ABB0) is a shared constant-zero provider for five flag/dispatch call sites. updateScroll (0x0047B1E0, UIComponentScroll DERIVED) is a per-frame scroll update switching on state +0x104. StateChangeNotification (0x00486660) and PropagateByteToLinkedChildren (0x004866AD) propagate UI state through subscriber/child chains using vtable slots +44/+56/+60 and StructFieldAccessor (0x00486320). The remaining functions are linked-list container helpers (destroy at +0x444/+0xE8, index lookup and unlink at +0x90, tail appends at +0xD0/+0xD8), a multi-container cleanup (0x00486080), constructors chaining ConstructorInitVTable (0x0047EFF0, 0x0047F080), a field reset (0x00486010), and small setters/stubs. All packet owners are UnknownObject except ScrollableUiList; every class here is DERIVED/GUESS synthesis.

function_roles.role: Multi-phase destructor (thiscall): installs the DB-object vtable off_5A4464, frees the child at +0x50, destroys the +0x3C interface-node list (node vtable slot 0 called with argument 1 when the node +12 flag is set), clears list fields, transitions the vtable through off_5A4450 and off_5A443C while freeing +0x30 and +0x4, then conditionally frees self on a2 bit 0 and returns this

Multi-phase destructor (thiscall): transitions the vtable through off_5A4478, off_5A4450 and off_5A443C, freeing the child pointers at +0x40, +0x30 and +0x4 in turn when non-null, then conditionally frees self on a2 bit 0 and returns this

Season scene path-match search (thiscall): walks the +0xF0 list, compares each node's path string at node+0x3C against global dword_7D0434 (fallback byte_5EA438) via 0x00588410, stores the visited-node count as the match index at +0x174, and always finishes by dispatching the virtual method at vtable offset 152; invoked from SeasonSceneInitialization

Media buffer manager destructor (thiscall): frees the +0x188 buffer when present, resets the vtable to off_5A4550, drains the +0xF0 buffer-reference node list (destroying each node's child object through its own vtable and freeing the node), zeroes +0xF0..+0xFC, chains the base destructor sub_485EB0, then conditionally frees self on a2 bit 0

Bounds check with position query (thiscall): reads current X/Y via DualFieldRead (0x00498880), guards a2 non-null, the X range (+0x120 min, +0x124 max) and the Y range (+0x140 min, +0x144 max), then finishes with RectangleBoundsCheck (0x0048EA60); returns the logical AND of all conditions; invoked by LinkedListTraversalVirtualCall

Scene command dispatch by mode (thiscall): if the discriminator at +0x180 equals 24 calls vtable slot +28 of global dword_7CD8C0 with command ID 23, otherwise with command ID 21, and returns the dispatch result; called by ShortComputation_75f0 and SeasonSceneInitialization

UI hit test (thiscall): reads reference coordinates via DualFieldRead from the object at +0x40, walks the +0x164 coordinate-node list (cursor +0x16C), compares reference position against node coordinates offset by +0xC/+0x4 within a +/-20 window, and writes the hit node index to +0x158 (-1 on miss); called by sub_478ED0

Season database object initializer (thiscall): chains the base constructor ShortComputation_5e30, installs vtable off_5A66E0, fills eleven DWORD fields (+0xE4..+0x100, +0x110..+0x118) with -1 sentinels, zeroes +0xE0/+0x104/+0x108/+0x10C, and returns this; called by SeasonDatabaseObjectFactory
Parameterless constant-zero stub: returns integer 0 unconditionally with no state changes and no reads; shared as a zero-result provider by five flag/dispatch call sites

Per-frame scroll update (thiscall): invokes vtable slot +44, reads selection/layout references via DualFieldRead from +0x40, advances the +0x108 float accumulator, switches on scroll state +0x104 (states 1-5 via jump table 0x0047B3C0: layout recompute + bounded counter, step down/up, clamped scroll delta via 0x0047BE00, step scroll via 0x0047BB40), and always finishes with vtable slot +84 and returns its result

State cleanup and byte reset (thiscall): notifies state machinery via StateCleanupNotification (0x00489CB0), writes 0 to the byte field at offset 0xe0 via ByteSetterAt0xe0 (0x0048A3B0), and unconditionally returns 0
Minimal object constructor (thiscall): invokes the base-object constructor ConstructorInitVTable (0x00488B00) with constants 1 and -1, writes the vtable pointer off_5A6D20 at +0x0, and returns this
Minimal object constructor (thiscall): invokes the base-object constructor ConstructorInitVTable (0x00488B00) with constants 1 and -1, writes the vtable pointer off_5A6DC8 at +0x0, and returns this

Load and process message buffer: reads the current vehicle description via VehicleDescriptionAccessor (0x00463C80) on global dword_7CD25C, validates it against the string table (byte_5EC4C0 / byte_5EC4CC) via BinarySearchInStringTable (0x00423A00), copies it into byte_5EC4CC when valid, drives the UI text update via UIStringComparison (0x00488B40), and falls back to byte_5EA438 on the null/empty path; returns 0 on both paths

Season/career database object factory: validates a type id against cache bounds, returns cached/out-of-range pointers directly, allocates per-type buffers for ids 1-45, runs the matching constructor, installs per-type vtable, caches at this[(id-1)+1607] and returns; id 436 uses a 772-byte bulk-init object; on allocation failure the cache slot is zeroed and 0 returned

Linked-list destructor (thiscall): walks the +0x444 list through node+4 next pointers, frees each node's double-indirect data buffer when the node+8 flag is set, frees every node, zeroes +0x444..+0x450, chains to LinkedListDestructor (0x0048CA50), then frees self on a2 bit 0 and returns this

Linked-list buffer destructor (thiscall): walks the +0xE8 list through node+4 next pointers, frees each node's double-indirect data buffer when the node+12 flag is set, frees every node, zeroes +0xE8..+0xF4, chains to InitWithVTableCleanup (0x00487250), then frees self on a2 bit 0 and returns this
Field initializer (thiscall): zeroes sixteen fields (byte +0x64, byte +0x6C, dwords +0x80..+0x9C and +0xC8..+0xDC), sets the byte at +0x65 to 1, and returns 0; called by sub_485E30

Multi-container cleanup (thiscall, no return value): frees four singly-linked node lists at +0xCC/+0xD0/+0xD4/+0xD8 (DualConditionalFree then FreeWrapper_7bcf, advanced via node[6]), drains a vtable-object list at +0x90 (StructFieldAccessor advance, first vtable entry invoked with argument 1, head zeroed), and frees an owned-data node list at +0x54 (data chain when the node+8 flag is set), zeroing +0x54..+0x60
Trivial inline setter (thiscall): stores the integer argument a2 into this[35] (byte offset +0x8C) and returns the same value; used by sub_486340 and ObjectRegistration

Zero-based index lookup into the singly-linked list rooted at this+0x90: rejects negative indices, returns the head for index zero, walks node+0x8C next pointers for positive indices, and returns null on an out-of-range walk; called by UIListManagementHandler

Linked-list node unlink (thiscall): if the head at this[36] (+0x90) is null returns 0; if the head is the target advances the head; otherwise walks node+0x8C next pointers, bypasses the removed node, zeroes its next pointer, decrements the counter at this[37] (+0x94), and returns the removed node; called by UIListManagementHandler

Linked-list tail append (thiscall, void): appends node a2 to the list whose head is at this+0xD0, walking node+0x18 next pointers to find the tail (or making a2 the head when the list is empty); called by sub_493480

Linked-list tail append (thiscall, void): appends node a2 to the list whose head is at this+0xD8, walking node+0x18 next pointers to find the tail (or making a2 the head when the list is empty); called by sub_493480

UI state propagation (thiscall): stores the state byte a2 at +0x64, fires the vtable slot +44 pre-change notification (argument 1) when the value changed, then walks the subscriber linked list at +0x90 invoking each node's vtable slot +56 with a2 and advancing via StructFieldAccessor

__userpurge UI widget value propagator: calls the virtual at vtable+44 (cdecl, argument 1), stores byte parameter a1 at this+101, then walks the child-node chain headed at this+144 invoking each node's vtable+60 virtual with a1 and advancing via StructFieldAccessor; returns the final next-pointer read (or the vtable+44 result when the chain is empty)

classes.name: UILayerObjectTearDown
classes.responsibility: Multi-phase vtable-switching teardown shared by two UI/DB object flavors: the vtable is walked through the HUD-layer vtable off_5A4450 and the control-base vtable off_5A443C (each flavor begins at its own vtable, off_5A4464 or off_5A4478), owned children are freed per phase, an interface-node linked list at +0x3C is destroyed via each node's vtable slot 0 with argument 1, and self is freed only when bit 0 of the deletion flag is set.

classes.name: MediaBufferManager
classes.responsibility: Destructor for a media buffer manager: frees the main media buffer at +0x188, resets the vtable to off_5A4550, drains a buffer-reference node list at +0xF0 (each node's child destroyed through the node's own vtable, then the node freed), zeroes the list state +0xF0..+0xFC, and chains the common base destructor sub_485EB0 before the conditional self-delete.

classes.name: SeasonSceneController
classes.responsibility: Season-scene list controller: SeasonPathMatchSearch walks the +0xF0 season-scene node list, compares node path strings (node+0x3C, fallback byte_5EA438) against the global season path dword_7D0434 (fallback byte_5EA438) via 0x00588410, stores the visited-node count as the match index at +0x174, and always finishes by dispatching vtable slot 152; dispatchSceneCommandByMode selects command 23 or 21 through global dword_7CD8C0 vtable slot +28 based on the +0x180 discriminator.

classes.name: RectangleBoundsChecker
classes.responsibility: Bounds containment check: reads the current X/Y position via DualFieldRead (0x00498880) and validates it against the bounding rectangle at +0x120/+0x124 (X) and +0x140/+0x144 (Y), finishing with RectangleBoundsCheck (0x0048EA60); returns true only when every condition holds.

classes.name: CoordinateListHitTester
classes.responsibility: UI hit test over a linked list of coordinate nodes: reads reference coordinates via DualFieldRead from the object at +0x40, walks the node list headed at +0x164 (cursor +0x16C, nodes carry a data pointer at +0 and next at +4), compares the reference position against node coordinates offset by +0xC/+0x4 within a +/-20 window, re-walks the list on a hit to compute the node index, and writes it to +0x158 (-1 on a miss).

classes.name: SeasonDatabaseObject
classes.responsibility: Initializer for a season/career database object: chains the base constructor ShortComputation_5e30 (0x00485E30), installs the vtable off_5A66E0, fills eleven DWORD fields with -1 sentinels (+0xE4..+0x100 and +0x110..+0x118), and zeroes +0xE0/+0x104/+0x108/+0x10C. The sentinel semantics are not documented in the packet.

classes.name: ZeroResultStubProvider
classes.responsibility: Parameterless stub returning the integer constant 0 with no state changes and no reads; shared as a constant-zero result provider by five flag/dispatch call sites (FlagSetInit, CallFlagSet, DeferredDeactivation, FlagCheckWithConditionalPathDispatch, TextureFlagTestWithDispatch).

classes.name: ScrollableUiList
classes.responsibility: Per-frame update of a scrollable UI component: invokes vtable slot +44, reads selection/layout references from the dual-field object at +0x40, advances the float accumulator +0x108, and switches on the scroll state +0x104 (states 1-5): relayout + bounded counter (0x0047B850, 0x0047BAE0), step down/up, clamped scroll delta (0x0047BE00) over +0x110/[0..+0x114], or step scroll (0x0047BB40); always ends with vtable slot +84 and returns its result.

classes.name: UiStateCleanupReceiver
classes.responsibility: Receiver of a state-cleanup notification and a byte reset: signals the state machinery via StateCleanupNotification (0x00489CB0), writes 0 to the byte at offset 0xe0 via ByteSetterAt0xe0 (0x0048A3B0), and returns 0. The offset 0xe0 is carried only by the callee's legacy name, not by field evidence in the packet.

classes.name: BaseInitializedObject
classes.responsibility: Two minimal thiscall constructors that chain the shared base-object initializer ConstructorInitVTable (0x00488B00) with constant arguments 1 and -1, then install their own vtable pointer at +0x0 (off_5A6D20 or off_5A6DC8) and return this. The literal pair (1, -1) and the vtable owners are not established.

classes.name: VehicleDescriptionUiUpdater
classes.responsibility: Loads the current vehicle description through VehicleDescriptionAccessor (0x00463C80) on the module-manager global dword_7CD25C, validates it against the string table (byte_5EC4C0 / byte_5EC4CC) via BinarySearchInStringTable (0x00423A00), copies the validated description into the message buffer byte_5EC4CC, drives the UI text update through UIStringComparison (0x00488B40), and falls back to the default path string byte_5EA438 when the description is null/empty; returns 0 on both paths.

classes.name: SeasonDatabaseRegistry
classes.responsibility: Season/career database object factory with per-type caching: validates a type id against the cache bounds, returns the already-cached pointer or 0 for out-of-range ids, and for ids 1-45 allocates a per-type buffer, runs the matching constructor, installs the per-type vtable, caches the result at dword index (id-1)+1607, and returns it. Id 436 uses a 772-byte bulk-init object. On allocation failure the cache slot is zeroed and 0 returned.

classes.name: OwnedBufferListContainer
classes.responsibility: Destructor for a linked list whose head lives at +0x444: walks nodes through +4 next pointers, frees each node's double-indirect data buffer (outer pointer at node+0, inner pointer freed first) when the node+8 flag is set, frees every node, zeroes +0x444..+0x450, chains the base LinkedListDestructor (0x0048CA50), and frees self when bit 0 of a2 is set.

classes.name: OwnedBufferListContainerE8
classes.responsibility: Destructor for a linked list whose head lives at +0xE8: walks nodes through +4 next pointers, frees each node's double-indirect data buffer (outer pointer at node+0, inner pointer freed first) when the node+12 flag is set, frees every node, zeroes +0xE8..+0xF4, chains the common cleanup InitWithVTableCleanup (0x00487250), and frees self when bit 0 of a2 is set.

classes.name: StateFieldInitializer
classes.responsibility: Field initializer that zeroes sixteen fields of the this-object (byte +0x64, byte +0x6C, dwords +0x80..+0x9C and +0xC8..+0xDC) and sets the byte at +0x65 to 1, returning 0; no reads, globals or calls. Called by sub_485E30.

classes.name: MultiContainerCleanupObject
classes.responsibility: Destructor-style cleanup of several heterogeneous container lists on one object: walks and frees four singly-linked node lists at +0xCC/+0xD0/+0xD4/+0xD8 (each node freed with DualConditionalFree (0x0049A5A0) then FreeWrapper_7bcf, advanced via node[6]), drains a vtable-object list at +0x90 (advancing via StructFieldAccessor and invoking the first vtable entry with argument 1, then zeroing the head), and walks an owned-data node list at +0x54 (freeing data chains when the node+8 flag is set), zeroing +0x54..+0x60.

classes.name: IntFieldSetter
classes.responsibility: Trivial inline setter storing an integer argument into the dword field at +0x8C and returning the stored value; used by sub_486340 and ObjectRegistration.

classes.name: UiListIndexAccessor
classes.responsibility: Index lookup and unlink operations on a singly-linked list rooted at this+0x90 with a node counter at +0x94 and nodes linked by a +0x8C next pointer: index lookup rejects negative indices, returns the head for index zero, and walks +0x8C next pointers; unlink bypasses a target node and decrements the counter. Both methods are called by UIListManagementHandler (0x0048A3C0).

classes.name: LinkedListTailAppender
classes.responsibility: Two tail-append methods for sibling linked lists whose heads live at +0xD0 and +0xD8: each appends a node by walking node+0x18 next pointers to the tail (or making the node the head when the list is empty). The indirect write base fields +0xE8/+0xF0 are decompiler attribution; both methods are called by sub_493480.

classes.name: StatePropagationComponent
classes.responsibility: UI state propagation: stores the incoming state byte at +0x64, fires the vtable slot +44 pre-change notification (argument 1) when the new value differs, then walks the subscriber linked list at +0x90 invoking each node's vtable slot +56 with the new byte and advancing via StructFieldAccessor (0x00486320).

classes.name: ChildValuePropagator
classes.responsibility: __userpurge UI widget value propagator: calls the virtual at vtable+44 (cdecl, argument 1), stores the byte parameter a1 at this+101, then walks a child-node chain headed at this+144 invoking each node's vtable+60 virtual with a1 and advancing via StructFieldAccessor, returning the final next-pointer read (or the vtable+44 result when the chain is empty).

transitions.condition: scroll_state at this+0x104 equals 1; recompute item layout via MenuItemLayoutCalculator (0x0047B850) into +0xE4 and move a bounded counter via BoundedCounterUpdate (0x0047BAE0)
scroll_state equals 2; if accumulator +0x108 > 0.125 decrement it and call BoundedCounterUpdate(this, -1)
scroll_state equals 3; if accumulator +0x108 > 0.125 decrement it and call BoundedCounterUpdate(this, 1)
scroll_state equals 4; compute scroll delta +0x110 = v10 - +0x11C clamped to [0, +0x114] and apply via sub_47BE00 (0x0047BE00)
scroll_state equals 5; if accumulator +0x108 > 0.25 decrement it and step-scroll via sub_47BB40 (0x0047BB40)
unhandled scroll_state; all paths converge on vtable slot +84 final refresh and its return value
discriminator at this+0x180 equals 24: dispatch vtable slot +28 of global dword_7CD8C0 with command ID 23
discriminator at this+0x180 differs from 24: dispatch vtable slot +28 of global dword_7CD8C0 with command ID 21

(BYTE)a2 differs from the stored byte at +0x64: fire the vtable slot +44 pre-change notification with argument 1, then store a2 at +0x64 and notify every subscriber in the +0x90 list via vtable slot +56 with a2
(BYTE)a2 equals the stored byte at +0x64: no pre-change notification fires, but the state byte is still stored and subscribers are still notified

interfaces.name: IGameCommandDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Dispatch interface behind global dword_7CD8C0: vtable slot +28 is invoked with a command ID (23 for the mode==24 path, 21 otherwise) from dispatchSceneCommandByMode (0x00477810). The interface type and the meaning of command IDs 21/23 are not established by this packet alone.

interfaces.name: INodeScalarDeleteDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Node virtual-destructor dispatch used by the container teardowns of 0x00476100 and 0x00476730: for each node in a linked container list, when the node flag byte is non-zero and the node vtable pointer is non-null, the destructor at vtable slot 0 is invoked with argument 1 (scalar-deleting pattern) and the node is then freed.

compatibility_contracts.name: UiControlMultiPhaseTearDownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the multi-phase teardown of 0x00476100 and 0x004761E0: the vtable pointer walks through the HUD-layer vtable off_5A4450 and the control-base vtable off_5A443C (from initial vtables off_5A4464 / off_5A4478), owned children are freed in phase order (+0x50/+0x30/+0x4 for one flavor, +0x40/+0x30/+0x4 for the other), the +0x3C interface-node list is destroyed by calling each node's vtable slot 0 with argument 1 when its +12 flag is set and its vtable is non-null, list fields +0x3C/+0x40/+0x44/+0x48 are cleared, and self is freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf only when bit 0 of the deletion flag is set; the this pointer is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: MediaBufferManagerDestructorContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the media buffer manager teardown of 0x00476730: the +0x188 main buffer is freed only when non-null, the vtable resets to off_5A4550, the +0xF0 buffer-reference list is drained (each node's child object destroyed through the node's own vtable when the node+12 flag is set and node value is non-null, then the node freed), the list state +0xF0..+0xFC is zeroed, the base destructor sub_485EB0 runs, and self is freed only when bit 0 of a2 is set.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonPathMatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the season-scene path search of 0x00476660: the list at +0xF0 is walked comparing each node's path string at node+0x3C (fallback byte_5EA438) against the season path global dword_7D0434 (fallback byte_5EA438) using 0x00588410 (0 == equality), the visited-node count is stored as the match index at +0x174, and the virtual method at vtable slot 152 is always dispatched at the end.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneCommandDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the mode-dependent dispatch of 0x00477810: when the discriminator at +0x180 equals 24, vtable slot +28 of global dword_7CD8C0 is called with command ID 23; otherwise the same slot is called with command ID 21; the dispatch result is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonDatabaseFactoryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the factory semantics of 0x0047F440: ids 1-45 allocate a per-type buffer, run the matching constructor, install the per-type vtable and cache the result at dword index (id-1)+1607; repeat or out-of-range ids return the cached/zero pointer without rebuilding; id 436 allocates a 772-byte bulk-init object via 0x00470230; allocation failure zeroes the cache slot and returns 0; id 1 (track database) initializes the string-buffer state and copies the filename literal (global 0x005BF970).

compatibility_contracts.name: UiHitTestContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the hit-test reporting of 0x00479320: reference coordinates are read via DualFieldRead from the object at +0x40, the +0x164 coordinate-node list is walked (cursor +0x16C), a hit requires the reference position to lie within +/-20 of the node center (node coordinates plus this+0xC/this+0x4), and on a hit the list is re-walked to compute the node index written to +0x158 (-1 on a miss).

compatibility_contracts.name: ScrollableListUpdateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the per-frame scroll update of 0x0047B1E0: vtable slot +44 is invoked before and vtable slot +84 after the scroll-state dispatch on +0x104, the +0x108 float accumulator advances per frame, and scroll states 1-5 drive layout recompute plus bounded counter movement (0x0047B850, 0x0047BAE0), step down/up, a clamped scroll delta (0x0047BE00 over +0x110 clamped to [0,+0x114]), or step scroll (0x0047BB40); the final vtable slot +84 result is returned.

compatibility_contracts.name: UiStatePropagationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the state propagation of 0x00486660: the incoming state byte is stored at +0x64, the vtable slot +44 pre-change notification fires with argument 1 when the byte changed, and every subscriber in the +0x90 linked list is notified through its vtable slot +56 with the new byte, advancing via StructFieldAccessor.

unresolved: All packet owners are UnknownObject except ScrollableUiList (DERIVED); every class here is GUESS synthesis and must not be treated as confirmed source structure.
The three vtables off_5A4464/off_5A4450/off_5A443C (and off_5A4478, off_5A4550, off_5A66E0, off_5A6D20, off_5A6DC8) are not tied to confirmed classes; their corpus identities are DERIVED at best.

The grouping of 0x00476100 and 0x004761E0 into UILayerObjectTearDown rests on the shared vtable chain off_5A4450 -> off_5A443C and the shared +0x4 owned resource; 0x00476730 is kept separate because it chains sub_485EB0 and owns a different list (+0xF0).
The virtual destructor invoked through each node's vtable in 0x00476100/0x00476730 is an indirect call; the concrete node class is unknown.
The a2 deletion-mode flag (bit 0 controls freeing self) has an unknown caller contract; 0x00476100 has no static callers.

The node layouts inside the +0x3C, +0x90, +0xE8, +0xF0, +0x164, +0x444, +0x54 lists (data/value pointer at +0, next at +4 / +0x8C / +0x18, flag byte at node+8 or node+12) are decompiler field attribution, not confirmed structs.

0x00476730's deterministic guard records the this+0xFC == 0 test as the walk guard while the raw source keys the loop on the head pointer this+0xF0; the sentinel-versus-head role is not fully resolvable from this packet.

The +0xE8/+0xF0 indirect write bases in 0x004864C0/0x00486540 are not visible in the raw source (which addresses the tail node directly via a local), so the identity of those base fields is unevidenced.

The semantics of the -1 sentinel fields and zeroed fields of the SeasonDatabaseObject are not documented; the cache slot base index 1607 (dword index) and its backing allocation are not independently confirmed.
dword_7CD8C0 is proposed as a game-command dispatch interface elsewhere; the interface type and command IDs 21/23 are not established by this function alone.
The owning object type and the +0xe0 byte-reset semantics of 0x0047C6C0 are unknown; the offset is carried only by the callee's legacy name.

The +/-20 hit-tolerance window, the +/-0.125/0.25 accumulator decrement constants (possibly backed by read-only globals flt_59E4E0 / flt_59E7F8), and the scroll-state meaning at +0x104 are inferred from literals, not confirmed by named fields.
0x004866AD's third parameter a3 is present in the signature but unused in the decompiled body.
The 0x00486080 caller relationship to sub_485EB0 is stated in the summary but not present in the packet's evidence refs; the sub_485EB0 edge is evidenced only through MediaBufferManagerDestructor.
Id 4 in 0x0047F440 jumps out of line to a block whose logic is not present in this function.

The DoubleIndirectFreeContract for 0x0047FBD0/0x004857E0 assumes the flag byte at node+8/node+12 gates a double-indirect buffer; the purpose of that buffering and of the extra header fields is unconfirmed.
